national_news.title: Union Cabinet Approves Two-Year Extension for Agniveers under Agnipath Scheme
bullets: The Union Cabinet approved a two-year extension of service for Agniveers, who were earlier set to exit after four years.
75 per cent of Agniveers who would have exited will now get an additional two-year engagement period with higher remuneration.
The Agnipath Scheme was originally launched on June 14, 2022, with the provision that 25 per cent of Agniveers would be permanently enrolled into regular armed forces based on merit.

national_news.title: Indo-Pacific Regional Dialogue 2026 Focuses on Science and Technology Cooperation
bullets: The Indo-Pacific Regional Dialogue 2026 (IPRD-2026) commenced in New Delhi on November 3, organized by the Indian Navy in association with the National Maritime Foundation (NMF).
The three-year conference is themed ‘Science, Technology and Academic Cooperation in the Indo-Pacific’, aiming to translate scientific advancements into practical regional cooperation.
Discussions focused on academic networks, marine research, human capital development, maritime situational awareness, and the protection of critical undersea infrastructure.

national_news.title: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh Addresses Third Delhi Defence Dialogue
bullets: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh addressed the third edition of the Delhi Defence Dialogue at the Manohar Parrikar Institute for Defence Studies and Analyses (MP-IDSA) on November 3, 2026.
The dialogue's theme was ‘Defence Reforms, Aatmanirbharta, Collaborations and Exports’, highlighting them as four interconnected pillars of India's vision for Viksit Bharat by 2047.
Key initiatives highlighted include the establishment of Defence Industrial Corridors and the corporatization of the Ordnance Factory Board into seven Defence Public Sector Undertakings (DPSUs).

national_news.title: PM Modi Inaugurates Hinjawadi-Shivajinagar Metro Line 3 and Phase-II Corridors in Pune
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi virtually inaugurated the 23-km Hinjawadi-Maan to Shivajinagar Metro Line 3 and laid the foundation stone for four Phase-II corridors with a total combined expenditure exceeding Rs 22,000 crore.
Metro Line 3 features 100% operations by women train operators and will source 30% of its energy requirement from solar power.
India's operational metro network has expanded from 248 km to over 1,200 km across 26 cities, facilitating daily transit for over one crore passengers.

national_news.title: NSE International Exchange at GIFT City Extends Daily Trading Hours to 23.5 Hours
bullets: NSE International Exchange (NSEIX) at GIFT City, Gujarat, extended its daily trading hours to 23.5 hours (3:15 AM IST to 2:45 AM IST next day) to facilitate global market participants.
Under the revised schedule, morning trading for GIFT Nifty (NSE IFSC Nifty 50 Index Futures) begins at 5:15 AM IST instead of 6:30 AM IST.
NSEIX is an international multi-asset exchange established in 2017 and regulated by the International Financial Services Centres Authority (IFSCA).

national_news.title: India Tops League Stage at Hero Asian Champions Trophy Hockey Tournament
bullets: The Indian Men's Hockey Team completed an undefeated league stage at the Hero Asian Champions Trophy by defeating South Korea 8-0 at Jalandhar, Punjab.
India finished at the top of the standings with five consecutive victories from five matches to advance to the semi-finals at Mohali.
Captain Harmanpreet Singh and Dilpreet Singh scored key goals as India registered 3 penalty corner conversions and 5 field goals.

national_news.title: King of Bhutan Dedicates Stupa 76 to Prime Minister Narendra Modi
bullets: Union Minority Affairs Minister Kiren Rijiju represented India at the consecration ceremony of 108 Stupas in Gelephu Mindfulness City, Bhutan.
Stupa number 76 was specifically dedicated to PM Narendra Modi by the King of Bhutan to honour his vision and bilateral friendship.
The 108 Stupas project features 15-meter tall monuments spread along the Aie River within the Gelephu Mindfulness City near the Assam border.

national_news.title: Union Sports Minister Mansukh Mandaviya Launches NDTL's Extramural Research Grant Policy at 10th WAADS Meeting 2026
bullets: Union Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports Mansukh Mandaviya launched the Extramural Research Grant Policy of the National Dope Testing Laboratory (NDTL) in New Delhi.
The policy aims to promote research and development in advanced detection and prevention of doping, strengthening India's zero-tolerance policy towards doping in sports.
India is preparing to host the Commonwealth Games in 2030 and aspires to host the 2036 Olympic Games.

bihar_news.title: Bihar becomes first state to introduce a comprehensive silt management policy
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister discussed the implementation of the state's pioneering silt management policy after a silt-removal agreement was signed with the Centre.
The policy aims to address recurring floods and utilize accumulated river silt for infrastructure development in the state.
Other discussed developments include industrial corridors like IMC Gaya and a major data centre inaugurated in Patna.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Museum in Patna secures ninth place globally and first in Asia
bullets: Bihar Museum in Patna has been ranked ninth worldwide and first in Asia in 'Worth a Journey's list of the world's 100 best museums.
Governor Syed Ata Hasnain congratulated the state Art and Culture Minister Pramod Kumar Chandravanshi and Museum Director Anjani Kumar for the achievement.
The announcement coincided with the launch of a cultural Bhojpuri Chhath song at the museum.

bihar_news.title: Revolt Motors Secures 1,100 BlazeX Electric Bikes Order from Bihar Police
bullets: Revolt Motors, a subsidiary of RattanIndia Enterprises, secured an institutional order to supply 1,100 BlazeX electric motorcycles to Bihar Police for patrolling purposes in Patna.
The contract delivery deadline is January 2027, but the company aims to complete deliveries ahead of schedule by November 2026.
The BlazeX electric bikes feature a range of up to 150 km, a removable battery, standard 10A socket charging, and built-in GPS tracking.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Deactivates Portals and Removes Striking Amins Amid Land Survey Backlog
bullets: The Bihar Revenue and Land Reforms Department ordered the immediate removal of striking land surveyors (amins) and deactivated their IDs on the e-Maapi portal.
District magistrates were directed to implement the replacement of striking personnel with special survey amins from block-level survey camps within 24 hours.
The action was taken to counter the rising backlog of land-survey and revenue-related public services caused by the ongoing agitation.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Farmer Mithilesh Kumar Singh Develops Crore-Plus Fisheries Enterprise with ICAR Support
bullets: Shri Mithilesh Kumar Singh from Rohtas district, Bihar, developed an 18-acre commercial aquaculture enterprise with an annual turnover exceeding ₹1 crore.

His entrepreneurial journey was built upon a seven-day training programme on Inland Fisheries Management organized by ICAR-Central Inland Fisheries Research Institute (CIFRI), Barrackpore, sponsored by the Department of Fisheries, Government of Bihar.
His production system features Indian Major Carps (Rohu, Catla, Mrigal) and Pangasius, yielding a net profit margin of 20-25%.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Highlights Constraints of Farakka Treaty on State's Industrial Water Access
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary stated that the Farakka Water Treaty restricts the state's access to Ganga water to only four months (July-October), impacting industrial and economic development.
The Farakka Water Treaty (Ganges Water Sharing Treaty) was signed between India and Bangladesh on December 12, 1996, with a 30-year framework expiring in December 2026.
The Chief Minister also noted that seven major rivers originating from Nepal's Terai region cause annual devastation and losses amounting to ₹10,000 crore in Bihar.

bihar_news.title: ICAR-MGIFRI Motihari Organizes Training on Climate-Smart Agriculture
bullets: ICAR-Mahatma Gandhi Integrated Farming Research Institute (MGIFRI) in Motihari organized a four-day residential training programme on climate-smart agriculture and crop diversification.
The training was sponsored by the Agricultural Technology Management Agency (ATMA), Siwan, Government of Bihar.
The programme focused on integrated farming systems (IFS), combining crops with livestock, fisheries, and horticulture to enhance resource-use efficiency and smallholder resilience.

bihar_news.title: Road Ministry Signs MoU with Bihar for River Silt Utilization in National Highways
bullets: The Ministry of Road Transport and Highways signed an MoU with Bihar to undertake scientific desilting of water bodies under the 'Nadi Sanjivani' initiative.
The plan intends to utilize 243 lakh cubic metres of silt in 16 ongoing National Highway projects and 835 lakh cubic metres for 27 future projects.
Currently, NHAI has 39 projects spanning 1,561 km under construction in Bihar with an investment of Rs 58,340 crore.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Couple Achieves Success as Entrepreneurs Under PMFME Scheme
bullets: Sanjay Kumar and Ranjana Kumari from Sheikhpura district successfully established 'Smriti Noodles' under the Pradhan Mantri Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME) scheme.
The food processing venture has provided regular employment to about 10 local people, empowering both men and women in the surrounding area.
Financial assistance from the central scheme enabled the installation of necessary machinery, making the family financially self-reliant and expanding their business to nearby districts like Nalanda.
